name: DEPLOY_IN_FLIGHT
comment: ANCHOR: DEPLOY_IN_FLIGHT_20261029 — Deploy console P1 (DSN-20261029-deploy-console), read-only in-flight board:
GET /api/v2/ops/in-flight (scripts/lib/deploy_in_flight.py) lists open PRs to main through `gh pr list` and
projects number/title/head SHA/mergeable/mergeStateStatus/why-held/next. No write path, no label/merge/push/
promote/schedule, no broker path. Hermetic: fixture PR dicts + injected lister; a gh failure is UNAVAILABLE, never 0.
